prompt:

Use ONLY the 10 verified listings in reference_denver_top10.json. For each listing write a '### <exact name>' heading, then 2-3 sentences using only the supplied facts (category, address, website, phone). Do not invent dishes, hours, prices, ratings or history.
Start with a 60-90 word intro on how to use the list. End the page with a short note that vegan status, hours and menus are checked on each business's site before publishing.
Then add the two delivery lines on their own lines: 'Label: not ready (draft awaiting editor checks)' and 'Human-reader check: pending'.
Then the review block exactly as the WRITER INSTRUCTIONS say.

rubric: Only the 10 supplied listings, exact names as ### headings
